items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: another one of my sisters, Louise

ctx.x: That's pretty hard to deal with. And I might say that incidentally I had an incident happen to me during that period of early childhood when the family was playing ball, and another one of my sisters, Louise -- we were playing ball and I was catching, and on her back swing she
hit me in the mouth with the bat. So if I show any signs of being slightly afflicted with insanity, of some sort, you can understand I've had several instances -- incidents that happened to cause it.
